title: 多规则异常交易筛查
context: 审计部门需要异常线索，不用于认定违规。
requirements: 发票粒度；同一供应商同编号重复、金额超过供应商平均发票金额2倍、超额付款、账单金额与对应采购行按收货计价相差超过100分；每条发票计算异常数，至少一个标记。发票单价或数量差异需复核。
grain: 发票（本模拟每采购单至多一张正常发票；重复异常专用）
commonError: 对每张发票使用整个采购单金额只有本模拟的一单一正常发票假设成立。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT v.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,invoice_no) copies,AVG(billed_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id) avg_bill FROM v_invoice_balance v), b AS (SELECT po_id,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) expected FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY po_id), z AS (SELECT a.*,CASE WHEN copies>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END duplicate_flag,CASE WHEN billed_cents>2*avg_bill THEN 1 ELSE 0 END large_flag,CASE WHEN balance_cents<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END overpay_flag,CASE WHEN ABS(billed_cents-COALESCE(b.expected,0))>100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mismatch_flag FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON b.po_id=a.po_id) SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,duplicate_flag,large_flag,overpay_flag,mismatch_flag,duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag flags FROM z WHERE duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag>0 ORDER BY flags DESC,supplier_invoice_id
